FAQ

Questions? Answered.

How long until I see SEO results?

For local home-service SEO, you can typically expect measurable ranking improvements within 60-90 days, with significant traffic growth over 4-6 months. SEO is a compounding investment — the results at month 6 are just the beginning.

Do you guarantee first-page rankings?

No ethical SEO agency can guarantee a specific ranking — Google controls the algorithm. What we guarantee is in writing: we agree on the metrics that matter to your business, and if they do not improve, we keep working until they do. You get a data-driven strategy, transparent reporting, and continuous optimization.

What industries do you work with?

We work exclusively with home-service trades — roofing, HVAC, plumbing, solar, electrical, and restoration. That focus means we already know the keywords, search intent, and local competitive landscape in your market.

How much does SEO cost?

Our SEO retainers start at $500/month and scale based on competition, target keywords, and content volume. We provide a custom quote after your free 48-hour audit — no obligation.

Can you work with my existing website?

Absolutely. We work with most platforms — WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Squarespace, and custom builds. Our technical team handles all on-site optimizations without disrupting your current design.
